指标 / Metric: 整系统L1通过率 / Overall L1 pass rate
说明 / Description: 运行、预期与回答合同；不判断事实支持 / Execution, expectations, response contract; no factual entailment check
规则与GPT；排除unclear及无标签题 / Rules plus GPT; excludes unclear and unlabelled cases, distinct from Part 1
区分各处理路径 / Distinguishes appointment, urgent contact, care and clarification

指标 / Metric: 危险案例召回率 / Urgent-case recall
说明 / Description: 只代表本批风险题 / Applies only to fixed urgent cases in this batch

指标 / Metric: 紧急误转介率 / Urgent false-referral rate
说明 / Description: 失败单独报告 / Failures reported separately, not counted as correct

指标 / Metric: 任何兽医误转介率 / Any-vet false-referral rate

指标 / Metric: 追问路径准确率 / Clarification action accuracy
说明 / Description: 追问有用性由L2判断 / L2 assesses usefulness of follow-up questions

按来源编号计数 / Counts source IDs, including partial multi-source coverage

指标 / Metric: 全部gold引用率 / All-gold citation rate
说明 / Description: 仅检查编号 / IDs alone do not establish factual correctness

指标 / Metric: 运行失败率 / Execution failure rate

指标 / Metric: L2复核完成率 / L2 review completion
说明 / Description: 本批布尔评分与非空理由 / Boolean judgment and nonempty justification for the matching batch
